# ECN-2026-030 Change notice - Machining hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02

Reason for change
- Update lubricant specification and control for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) to align maintenance supply records and supplier packaging. The lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is CFW-LUB-497. This change reduces part number mismatches between maintenance materials management and the shop floor.

Affected items
- Equipment lubrication record for EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
- Spare stock item in MM-P1-L3-HP02 reflecting the lubricant part number.
- Machine shop standard box and labels that reference the previous lubricant identifier; see SB-1029 for current container labeling requirements.
- Operator and maintenance job instructions in SOP-P1-L3-01 where lubricant identification is called out.

Implementation
- Update the spare parts master entry in MM-P1-L3-HP02 to reflect CFW-LUB-497 as the authorized lubricant for EQ-P1-L3-HP02. Coordinate with stores to relabel existing containers and to accept deposits of CFW-LUB-497 only.
- Revise the label template per SB-1029 to show CFW-LUB-497 and place new labels on the in-use reservoir and the shop storage location for EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
- Revise lubricant reference lines in SOP-P1-L3-01 to specify CFW-LUB-497. Issue a controlled bulletin to affected maintenance personnel and operators indicating the authorized part number and the expected container labeling; reference this ECN.
- Perform a visual verification of labeling and inventory records for EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and the associated storage location. Document verification in the equipment history record.

Approvals
- Maintenance Manager: approval required for change to MM-P1-L3-HP02 records.
- Reliability Engineer: approval required for revision to SOP-P1-L3-01.
- Stores Supervisor: approval required for receipt and relabeling of CFW-LUB-497 inventory.

Related documents: MM-P1-L3-HP02, SB-1029, SOP-P1-L3-01
